description: This file defines a ContentProvider for weather data that stores and provides access to weather temperature data for different days. It includes a data class, WeatherDataPoint, and the primary class, WeatherDataProvider, which manages in-memory weather data, handles queries, updates, and overrides relevant ContentProvider methods.

classes.name: WeatherDataPoint
classes.description: A simple data class representing a weather data point with a day label and temperature in degrees.

classes.name: WeatherDataProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider that manages in-memory weather data for a widget; handles data querying and updating.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory weather data with default values when the provider is created.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns a Cursor over all weather data entries in response to query requests.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the data provided, indicating it is a directory of weather temperature entries.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Stub for insert operation; not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Stub for delete operation; not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the temperature for a specific weather data point and notifies listeners of change.
